<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>6/49 Bingo Pool & Payment Manager</title>
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/js/all.min.js"></script>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500;700&display=swap');
body {
font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
}
.font-mono-numbers {
font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
}
/* Bingo Circled Match Highlight Animations */
.lotto-ball {
display: inline-flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
width: 2.25rem;
height: 2.25rem;
border-radius: 9999px;
font-weight: 700;
font-size: 0.875rem;
transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
position: relative;
}
/* Red/Gold circled stamp when drawn number matches */
.lotto-ball.matched {
background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #fef08a 0%, #eab308 55%, #ca8a04 100%);
color: #713f12;
box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #ef4444, 0 4px 10px rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.5);
transform: scale(1.08);
font-weight: 800;
}
.lotto-ball.matched::after {
content: '';
position: absolute;
inset: -4px;
border: 2px dashed #dc2626;
border-radius: 9999px;
animation: rotateRing 14s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes rotateRing {
from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}
.lotto-ball.unmatched {
background-color: #f1f5f9;
color: #334155;
border: 1.5px solid #cbd5e1;
}
.dark .lotto-ball.unmatched {
background-color: #1e293b;
color: #cbd5e1;
border: 1.5px solid #334155;
}
/* Custom scrollbars for spreadsheet tables */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
height: 8px;
width: 8px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
background: #f1f5f9;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
background: #cbd5e1;
border-radius: 4px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
background: #94a3b8;
}
@media print {
.no-print { display: none !important; }
body { background: white !important; color: black !important; }
.sheet-container { border: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body class="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 min-h-screen flex flex-col">
<!-- Main Navigation Header with Mode Switcher -->
<header class="bg-slate-900 text-white shadow-lg sticky top-0 z-30 border-b border-slate-800">
<div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-3.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
<div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-amber-500 to-rose-500 flex items-center justify-center shadow-md">
<i class="fa-solid fa-dice-six text-xl text-white"></i>
</div>
<div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<h1 class="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white">6/49 Bingo Pool</h1>
<span id="header-mode-badge" class="text-xs bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center gap-1.5">
<span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse"></span> Player View
</span>
</div>
<p class="text-xs text-slate-400">50 Players • 50/50 Pot ($25 Entry) • 6 Weekly Draws</p>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Mode Controls (Player View vs Admin Login/Logout) -->
<div class="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
<div id="player-mode-actions" class="flex items-center gap-2">
<button onclick="openPlayerSubmissionModal()" class="px-3.5 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-500 to-teal-600 hover:from-emerald-400 hover:to-teal-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl text-xs shadow-md transition flex items-center gap-1.5 animate-pulse">
<i class="fa-solid fa-file-signature"></i> Submit Your Numbers ($25)
</button>
<button onclick="openAdminLoginModal()" class="px-3.5 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-amber-600 hover:from-amber-400 hover:to-amber-500 text-slate-950 font-bold rounded-xl text-xs shadow-md transition flex items-center gap-1.5">
<i class="fa-solid fa-lock"></i> Admin Portal
</button>
</div>
<div id="admin-mode-actions" class="hidden flex items-center gap-2">
<span class="text-xs bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-amber-500/40 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5">
<i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved text-amber-400"></i> Admin Signed In
</span>
<button onclick="exportToCSV()" class="px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition flex items-center gap-1.5">
<i class="fa-solid fa-file-excel text-emerald-400"></i> Export CSV
</button>
<button onclick="exitAdminMode()" class="px-3 py-2 bg-rose-900/60 hover:bg-rose-900 text-rose-200 border border-rose-700/50 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition flex items-center gap-1.5">
<i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right-from-bracket"></i> Exit to Player View
</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Admin Navigation Tabs (Only visible when Admin is logged in) -->
<div id="admin-nav-bar" class="hidden max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 flex overflow-x-auto gap-1 border-t border-slate-800 pt-1">
<button onclick="switchAdminTab('payment-tracker')" id="admin-tab-payment-tracker" class="admin-tab-btn px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold border-b-2 border-amber-500 text-amber-400 flex items-center gap-2 transition whitespace-nowrap">
<i class="fa-solid fa-receipt"></i> 50/50 Payment Ledger & Player Names
<span id="paid-badge-counter" class="bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-700/50">0/50</span>
</button>
<button onclick="switchAdminTab('draw-manager')" id="admin-tab-draw-manager" class="admin-tab-btn px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold border-b-2 border-transparent text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-2 transition whitespace-nowrap">
<i class="fa-solid fa-list-check"></i> Enter 6 Weekly Draws
<span id="draws-completed-badge" class="bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-rose-700/50">0/6 Drawn</span>
</button>
<button onclick="switchAdminTab('player-numbers')" id="admin-tab-player-numbers" class="admin-tab-btn px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold border-b-2 border-transparent text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-2 transition whitespace-nowrap">
<i class="fa-solid fa-users-gear"></i> Edit Player 6/49 Numbers
</button>
<button onclick="switchAdminTab('stats-prizes')" id="admin-tab-stats-prizes" class="admin-tab-btn px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold border-b-2 border-transparent text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-2 transition whitespace-nowrap">
<i class="fa-solid fa-trophy"></i> 50/50 Financial Pot Breakdown
</button>
</div>
</header>
<main class="max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 flex-1 space-y-6">
<!-- ========================================== -->
<!-- PLAYER VIEW CONTAINER (Public Display) -->
<!-- ========================================== -->
<div id="section-player-view" class="space-y-6">
<!-- Official Drawn Numbers Display (Public & Read-Only) -->
<section class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm border border-slate-200">
<div class="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
<div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
<span class="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-extrabold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 flex items-center gap-1.5">
<i class="fa-solid fa-bullseye"></i> Official 6/49 Drawn Numbers
</span>
<div id="player-draw-tabs-selector" class="flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-lg">
<!-- Rendered by JS: Cumulative button + Draw 1..6 buttons -->
</div>
</div>
<h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1" id="player-active-draw-title">All 6 Draws Cumulative View</h2>
<p class="text-xs text-slate-500" id="player-active-draw-subtitle">Numbers drawn across all 6 weekly draws are automatically circled in gold on each player card.</p>
</div>
<!-- Winning Numbers Display Row -->
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
<div id="player-drawn-balls-container" class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
<!-- Rendered by JS -->
</div>
<div class="h-8 w-px bg-slate-200 mx-1 hidden sm:block"></div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 pl-1">
<span class="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase">Bonus:</span>
<div id="player-bonus-ball-display" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full border-2 border-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 font-bold flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-mono-numbers">
--
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Pot & Bingo Hits Quick Stats for Players -->
<div class="flex items-center gap-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-xl p-3 border border-slate-200 text-xs">
<div>
<p class="text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase">50% Winner Pot</p>
<p id="player-stat-winner-pot" class="text-lg font-extrabold text-emerald-600">$0.00</p>
</div>
<div class="h-6 w-px bg-slate-200"></div>
<div>
<p class="text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase">6/6 Bingo Hits</p>
<p id="player-stat-match-6" class="text-lg font-extrabold text-amber-600">0</p>
</div>
<div class="h-6 w-px bg-slate-200"></div>
<div>
<p class="text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase">5/6 Hits</p>
<p id="player-stat-match-5" class="text-lg font-extrabold text-blue-600">0</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Player Bingo Master Sheet Table -->
<section class="space-y-4">
<!-- Search and Filter Bar -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
<div class="flex items-center gap-3 flex-1 min-w-[260px]">
<div class="relative w-full max-w-sm">
<i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass absolute left-3.5 top-3 text-slate-400 text-xs"></i>
<input type="text" id="player-bingo-search" oninput="renderPlayerBingoSheet()" placeholder="Search your slot or player name..." class="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 text-xs rounded-lg border border-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500">
</div>
<select id="player-bingo-filter-status" onchange="renderPlayerBingoSheet()" class="text-xs px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500">
<option value="all">All 50 Players</option>
<option value="with-matches">With Matches (>= 1)</option>
<option value="top-scorers">Top Match Leaders</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<span class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium">Legend:</span>
<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-amber-800 bg-amber-50 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md border border-amber-200">
<span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-amber-400 border-2 border-red-500 shadow-sm"></span> Circled Ball = 6/49 Hit!
</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Master Sheet Grid -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden">
<div class="overflow-x-auto">
<table class="w-full text-left border-collapse">
<thead>
<tr class="bg-slate-800 text-white text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">
<th class="py-3 px-4 w-20 text-center">Slot</th>
<th class="py-3 px-4 min-w-[200px]">Player Name</th>
<th class="py-3 px-4 text-center w-28">Status</th>
<th class="py-3 px-4 text-center min-w-[340px]">Chosen 6/49 Numbers (1 - 49)</th>
<th class="py-3 px-4 text-center w-24">Bonus Ball</th>
<th class="py-3 px-4 text-center w-24">Total Hits</th>
<th class="py-3 px-4 text-center w-32">Standing</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody id="player-bingo-table-body" class="divide-y divide-slate-200 text-xs">
<!-- Rendered via JS -->
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
<!-- ========================================== -->
<!-- ADMIN PORTAL CONTAINER (Restricted Tools) -->
<!-- ========================================== -->
<div id="section-admin-view" class="hidden space-y-6">
<!-- Admin Status Banner -->

<div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm shadow">

</div>

</div>
</div>

</button>

</button>
</div>
</div>

<span class="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Play 1 through Play 50</span>
</div>

<span class="text-[11px] text-slate-400">• <span id="total-unpaid-count" class="font-semibold text-rose-500">50</span> Unpaid</span>

</div>

<div>
<p class="text-xs text-slate-500 font-semibold uppercase">Total Pot Collected</p>
<p id="total-pot-amount" class="text-2xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 mt-1">$0.00</p>

</div>

</div>

<!-- Ledger Settings & Bulk Actions -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<label class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600">Entry Fee ($):</label>
<input type="number" id="pool-entry-fee" value="25" min="1" max="1000" onchange="updateEntryFee(this.value)" class="w-20 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg border border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500">
</div>
<div class="h-6 w-px bg-slate-200 hidden sm:block"></div>
<div class="relative">
<i class="fa-solid fa-filter absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400 text-xs"></i>
<select id="payment-filter" onchange="renderPaymentLedger()" class="pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white">
<option value="all">Show All 50 Slots</option>
<option value="paid">Show Paid Only</option>
<option value="unpaid">Show Unpaid Only</option>
</select>
</div>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<button onclick="markAllPaid(true)" class="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 rounded-lg border border-emerald-200 transition">
<i class="fa-solid fa-check-double mr-1"></i> Mark All Paid ($25)
</button>
<button onclick="markAllPaid(false)" class="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-rose-700 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 rounded-lg border border-rose-200 transition">
<i class="fa-solid fa-xmark mr-1"></i> Reset Payments
</button>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Payment Spreadsheet Table -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden">
<div class="overflow-x-auto">

<tr class="bg-slate-800 text-white text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">
<th class="py-3 px-4 w-20 text-center">Slot</th>
<th class="py-3 px-4 w-28">Slot ID</th>
<th class="py-3 px-4 min-w-[200px]">Assigned Player Legal Name <span class="text-amber-300 font-normal">(Unlocked when Paid)</span></th>
<th class="py-3 px-4 w-32">Phone #</th>
<th class="py-3 px-4 text-center w-36">Payment Action</th>
<th class="py-3 px-4 w-28">Amount ($)</th>
<th class="py-3 px-4 w-36">Method</th>
<th class="py-3 px-4 w-36">Date Paid</th>
<th class="py-3 px-4 min-w-[200px]">Notes / Receipt #</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody id="payment-table-body" class="divide-y divide-slate-200 text-xs">
<!-- Rendered via JS -->
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div>
<h3 class="text-base font-bold text-slate-800">Total 6 6/49 Entries Schedule & Results</h3>
<p class="text-xs text-slate-500">Enter each of the 6 official 6/49 weekly draws. Every drawn number automatically updates player Bingo cards.</p>

<i class="fa-solid fa-dice text-rose-600"></i> Simulate All 6 Draws
</button>
<button onclick="resetAllDraws()" class="px-3 py-2 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg border border-rose-200 transition flex items-center gap-1.5">

</button>

</div>

</div>

<button onclick="openPlayerModal(getFirstUnfilledPlayerId())" class="px-3.5 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm">
<i class="fa-solid fa-plus-circle"></i> Enter Next Player Numbers
</button>
<button onclick="randomizeAllPlayerNumbers()" class="px-3.5 py-2 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-300 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center gap-1.5">
<i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles"></i> Quick-Pick Empty Slots
</button>
</div>
</div>

<div class="overflow-x-auto">
<table class="w-full text-left border-collapse">

<tr class="bg-slate-800 text-white text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">

</table>

<div id="admin-view-stats-prizes" class="admin-tab-view hidden space-y-5">

<div class="bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-3">
<h3 class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
<i class="fa-solid fa-hand-holding-dollar text-emerald-600"></i> 50/50 Pool Financial Split
</h3>
<p class="text-xs text-slate-500">Based on $25 entry per player across 50 slots ($1,250 max pot):</p>
<div class="space-y-3 text-xs pt-2">
<div class="p-3 bg-amber-50 rounded-xl border border-amber-200">
<div class="flex items-center justify-between">
<span class="font-bold text-amber-900">Winner(s) Share (50%)</span>
<span id="prize-calc-winner" class="font-extrabold text-amber-700 text-sm">$0.00</span>
</div>
<p class="text-[11px] text-amber-700 mt-1">Goes to player(s) with the most matches or 6/6 Bingo across all 6 draws.</p>
</div>

<div class="flex items-center justify-between">
<span class="font-bold text-emerald-900">Organization / House (50%)</span>
<span id="prize-calc-org" class="font-extrabold text-emerald-700 text-sm">$0.00</span>
</div>
<p class="text-[11px] text-emerald-700 mt-1">Retained by the organization hosting the pool.</p>
</div>

<div class="flex items-center justify-between">
<span class="font-bold text-slate-700">Total Pot Collected</span>
<span id="prize-calc-total" class="font-bold text-slate-800">$0.00</span>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center justify-between mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
<span>Slots Sold:</span>

</div>
</div>
</div>

<i class="fa-solid fa-chart-column text-indigo-500"></i> 50-Player Number Frequency & Heatmap (1-49)
</h3>
<p class="text-xs text-slate-500">Distribution of player numbers chosen across all 50 cards.</p>
<div id="number-heatmap" class="grid grid-cols-7 sm:grid-cols-10 md:grid-cols-10 gap-1.5 pt-2">

<!-- Admin Login Modal -->
<div id="admin-login-modal" class="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 hidden">

<div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm">
<i class="fa-solid fa-lock"></i>
</div>
<div>
<h3 class="text-base font-bold">Admin Portal Access</h3>
<p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400">For authorized pool managers</p>
</div>
</div>
<button onclick="closeAdminLoginModal()" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-white text-lg p-1">
<i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
</button>
</div>
<div class="p-6 space-y-4">
<div>
<label class="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Enter Administrator PIN</label>
<input type="password" id="admin-pin-input" placeholder="Default PIN: 1234" class="w-full text-center tracking-widest text-lg font-bold px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-300 focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500" onkeydown="if(event.key === 'Enter') submitAdminLogin()">
<p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 text-center mt-1.5">Default PIN is <span class="font-mono font-bold text-slate-600">1234</span></p>
</div>
<div id="admin-login-error" class="hidden p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-700 text-xs font-medium text-center"></div>
<div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
<button onclick="closeAdminLoginModal()" class="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-800 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 rounded-xl transition">
Cancel
</button>
<button onclick="submitAdminLogin()" class="px-5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-950 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 rounded-xl shadow-md transition flex items-center gap-1.5">
<i class="fa-solid fa-unlock"></i> Unlock Admin
</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Draw Modal -->
<div id="draw-modal" class="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 hidden">
<div class="bg-white w-full max-w-lg rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden transform transition-all">
<div class="bg-slate-900 text-white p-5 flex items-center justify-between">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-rose-600 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm">
<i class="fa-solid fa-dice"></i>
</div>
<div>
<h3 class="text-base font-bold" id="modal-draw-header">Enter 6/49 Draw</h3>
<p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Select which draw (1 to 6) to enter official winning numbers</p>
</div>
</div>
<button onclick="closeDrawModal()" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-white text-lg p-1">
<i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i>
</button>
</div>
<div class="p-6 space-y-5">
<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
<div>
<label class="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Target Draw (1 - 6)</label>
<select id="modal-draw-index" onchange="onModalDrawIndexChange()" class="w-full text-xs font-bold px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-rose-500">
<option value="0">Draw #1</option>
<option value="1">Draw #2</option>
<option value="2">Draw #3</option>
<option value="3">Draw #4</option>
<option value="4">Draw #5</option>
<option value="5">Draw #6</option>
</select>
</div>
<div>
<label class="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Draw Date</label>
<input type="date" id="modal-draw-date" class="w-full text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-rose-500">
</div>
</div>
<div>
<div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
<label class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wide">6 Main Drawn Numbers (1 to 49)</label>
<button onclick="randomizeDrawNumbersModal()" class="text-[11px] font-semibold text-rose-600 hover:text-rose-700 flex items-center gap-1">
<i class="fa-solid fa-dice text-xs"></i> Simulate Random Draw
</button>
</div>
<div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-2">
<input type="number" id="draw-num-1" min="1" max="49" placeholder="#" class="draw-modal-input text-center font-bold text-base py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-rose-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-rose-500">
<input type="number" id="draw-num-2" min="1" max="49" placeholder="#" class="draw-modal-input text-center font-bold text-base py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-rose-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-rose-500">
<input type="number" id="draw-num-3" min="1" max="49" placeholder="#" class="draw-modal-input text-center font-bold text-base py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-rose-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-rose-500">
<input type="number" id="draw-num-4" min="1" max="49" placeholder="#" class="draw-modal-input text-center font-bold text-base py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-rose-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-rose-500">
<input type="number" id="draw-num-5" min="1" max="49" placeholder="#" class="draw-modal-input text-center font-bold text-base py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-rose-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-rose-500">
<input type="number" id="draw-num-6" min="1" max="49" placeholder="#" class="draw-modal-input text-center font-bold text-base py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-rose-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-rose-500">
</div>
</div>
<div>
<label class="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Bonus Ball (Optional)</label>
<div class="w-24">
<input type="number" id="draw-bonus-num" min="1" max="49" placeholder="Bonus" class="text-center font-bold text-base py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-indigo-200 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 w-full">
</div>
</div>
<div id="draw-modal-error" class="hidden p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-700 text-xs font-medium"></div>
<div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
<button onclick="closeDrawModal()" class="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-800 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 rounded-xl transition">
Cancel
</button>
<button onclick="submitDrawNumbers()" class="px-5 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 rounded-xl shadow-md transition flex items-center gap-1.5">
<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Save This Draw
</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<!-- 6 Number Inputs -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-6 gap-2">
<input type="number" id="p-num-1" min="1" max="49" onchange="syncAdminGridFromInputs()" class="p-num-input text-center font-bold text-sm py-2 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-300 focus:border-amber-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500">

<script>
const STORAGE_KEY = '649_bingo_pool_v2';
const DRAWS_KEY = '649_bingo_draws_v2';
const ADMIN_PIN = '1234';
let isAdminLoggedIn = false;
let currentAdminTab = 'payment-tracker';
let entryFee = 25;
let selectedDrawView = 'cumulative'; // 'cumulative' or 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
// Exactly 6 6/49 entries
let draws = [
{ id: 1, name: 'Draw #1', date: '', numbers: [], bonus: null },
{ id: 2, name: 'Draw #2', date: '', numbers: [], bonus: null },
{ id: 3, name: 'Draw #3', date: '', numbers: [], bonus: null },
{ id: 4, name: 'Draw #4', date: '', numbers: [], bonus: null },
{ id: 5, name: 'Draw #5', date: '', numbers: [], bonus: null },
{ id: 6, name: 'Draw #6', date: '', numbers: [], bonus: null },
];
let players = [];
// Helper: generate 6 unique random numbers between 1 and 49
function generateQuickPick() {
const set = new Set();
while (set.size < 6) {
set.add(Math.floor(Math.random() * 49) + 1);
}
return Array.from(set).sort((a, b) => a - b);
}
// Initialize 50 players labeled "Play 1", "Play 2" ... "Play 50"
function initializeDefaultPlayers() {
const list = [];
for (let i = 1; i <= 50; i++) {
list.push({
id: i,
label: `Play ${i}`,
name: '', // Added after payment or player submission
phone: '',
paid: false,
amountPaid: 0,
paymentMethod: 'Cash',
paymentDate: '',
notes: '',
numbers: generateQuickPick()
});
}
return list;
}
function loadState() {
try {
const savedPlayers = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
if (savedPlayers) {
players = JSON.parse(savedPlayers);
// ensure backwards compatibility for phone field and array count
players.forEach((p, idx) => {
if (p.phone === undefined) p.phone = '';
if (!p.numbers || p.numbers.length === 0) p.numbers = generateQuickPick();
});
if (players.length < 50) {
for (let i = players.length + 1; i <= 50; i++) {
players.push({
id: i,
label: `Play ${i}`,
name: '',
phone: '',
paid: false,
amountPaid: 0,
paymentMethod: 'Cash',
paymentDate: '',
notes: '',
numbers: generateQuickPick()
});
}
}
} else {
players = initializeDefaultPlayers();
}
const savedDraws = localStorage.getItem(DRAWS_KEY);
if (savedDraws) {
const parsed = JSON.parse(savedDraws);
if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length === 6) {
draws = parsed;
}
}
} catch (e) {
console.error('Error loading saved state:', e);
players = initializeDefaultPlayers();
}
}
function saveState() {
try {
localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(players));
localStorage.setItem(DRAWS_KEY, JSON.stringify(draws));
} catch (e) {
console.error('Failed to save to localStorage:', e);
}
}
function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
const toastMsg = document.getElementById('toast-message');
const toastIcon = document.getElementById('toast-icon');
toastMsg.textContent = message;
if (type === 'success') {
toastIcon.className = 'fa-solid fa-circle-check text-emerald-400';
} else if (type === 'info') {
toastIcon.className = 'fa-solid fa-circle-info text-blue-400';
} else {
toastIcon.className = 'fa-solid fa-triangle-exclamation text-rose-400';
}
toast.classList.remove('translate-y-12', 'opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
setTimeout(() => {
toast.classList.add('translate-y-12', 'opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
}, 2800);
}
function openAdminLoginModal() {
document.getElementById('admin-pin-input').value = '';
document.getElementById('admin-login-error').classList.add('hidden');
document.getElementById('admin-login-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('admin-pin-input').focus(), 100);
}
function closeAdminLoginModal() {
document.getElementById('admin-login-modal').classList.add('hidden');
}
function submitAdminLogin() {
const pin = document.getElementById('admin-pin-input').value.trim();
const err = document.getElementById('admin-login-error');
if (pin === ADMIN_PIN) {
isAdminLoggedIn = true;
closeAdminLoginModal();
applyViewMode();
showToast('Admin Mode Unlocked! You can now manage payments, names and draws.');
} else {
err.textContent = 'Incorrect PIN. Please enter "1234".';
err.classList.remove('hidden');
}
}
function exitAdminMode() {
isAdminLoggedIn = false;
applyViewMode();
showToast('Returned to Public Player View', 'info');
}
function applyViewMode() {
const playerContainer = document.getElementById('section-player-view');
const adminContainer = document.getElementById('section-admin-view');
const playerActions = document.getElementById('player-mode-actions');
const adminActions = document.getElementById('admin-mode-actions');
const adminNavBar = document.getElementById('admin-nav-bar');
const headerBadge = document.getElementById('header-mode-badge');
if (isAdminLoggedIn) {
playerContainer.classList.add('hidden');
adminContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
playerActions.classList.add('hidden');
adminActions.classList.remove('hidden');
adminNavBar.classList.remove('hidden');
headerBadge.className = 'text-xs bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-amber-500/30 flex items-center gap-1.5';
headerBadge.innerHTML = '<span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400"></span> Admin Control Center';
switchAdminTab(currentAdminTab);
} else {
playerContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
adminContainer.classList.add('hidden');
playerActions.classList.remove('hidden');
adminActions.classList.add('hidden');
adminNavBar.classList.add('hidden');
headerBadge.className = 'text-xs bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center gap-1.5';
headerBadge.innerHTML = '<span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse"></span> Player View';
renderPlayerHeader();
renderPlayerBingoSheet();
}
}
function switchAdminTab(tabId) {
currentAdminTab = tabId;
document.querySelectorAll('.admin-tab-view').forEach(view => view.classList.add('hidden'));
document.querySelectorAll('.admin-tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
btn.classList.remove('border-amber-500', 'text-amber-400');
btn.classList.add('border-transparent', 'text-slate-400');
});
const targetView = document.getElementById(`admin-view-${tabId}`);
const targetBtn = document.getElementById(`admin-tab-${tabId}`);
if (targetView && targetBtn) {
targetView.classList.remove('hidden');
targetBtn.classList.remove('border-transparent', 'text-slate-400');
targetBtn.classList.add('border-amber-500', 'text-amber-400');
}
if (tabId === 'payment-tracker') renderPaymentLedger();
if (tabId === 'draw-manager') renderDrawManager();
if (tabId === 'player-numbers') renderAdminPlayerNumbersTable();
if (tabId === 'stats-prizes') {
renderHeatmap();
renderPrizeStats();
